svg.title: Methyl orange: yellow azo form and red quinoid form (pH dependent)
svg.desc: Methyl orange acid base equilibrium between yellow azo and red quinoid forms
svg.text: Methyl orange: yellow azo form and red quinoid form (pH dependent)
Protonation of the azo N converts the benzenoid system into a quinoid one → absorption shifts to longer λ (bathochromic).
